dedupe_keys.name: hitic ncp daily human thermal stress indices

description: Sun Yat-sen University and collaborators publish HiTIC-NCP, a daily collection of human thermal-stress indices covering the North China Plain from 2003 to 2020. It includes surface air temperature and eleven human thermal indices, such as apparent temperature, heat index, wet-bulb temperature and wind chill. The 1 km WGS84 grids are distributed as yearly NetCDF stacks in RAR archives, free under CC BY 4.0. Stored integer values must be divided by 100 to obtain degrees Celsius. The grids can support heat-exposure and climate-adaptation simulations, including contextual comparisons with building simulations in model-energyplus. A caveat is that these reconstructed indices are not indoor observations for individual buildings or measurements of health outcomes. Each index embodies particular environmental and physiological assumptions. The file inventory and encoding description were inspected without downloading grids or independently checking accuracy.
